source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top Ret parses
summary: Judge → reapply Seal → Crusader Strike on cooldown → auto attack with 2H weapon. Seal of Blood (Horde) or Seal of Command (Alliance). Sanctity Aura provides +10% holy damage to the raid. Avenging Wrath on cooldown.

Holy Light.note: large heal  -  a ret paladin healing heavily in a DPS parse indicates an emergency or wrong role assignment

Flash of Light.note: fast heal  -  some spot-healing is normal but heavy Flash of Light use is a DPS loss

Holy Shield.note: Protection ability requiring a shield  -  wrong spec/gear for Ret

Shield of Righteousness.note: Protection ability  -  wrong spec for Ret

breakpoint.note: The TBC Ret rotation is tight: Crusader Strike (6s cooldown) → Judge → reapply Seal → fill with auto attacks. Judgement should appear roughly every 8-10 seconds. Consecration is mana-expensive but contributes meaningful DPS  -  high mana rogues or those with good gear use it consistently.

advisory: IMPORTANT: Divine Storm does NOT exist in TBC Classic  -  it was added in Wrath 3.0. Any Ret parse in TBC will not show Divine Storm. Sanctity Aura (+10% holy damage) should be active  -  confirm the paladin is using Sanctity and not Devotion or Retribution Aura unless the raid leader assigned otherwise. Avenging Wrath ('wings', +20% damage for 20s, 3-minute cooldown) should appear regularly. Exorcism is only usable against Undead and Demons  -  it will not appear on non-undead bosses.
